sentences.text: Arenicolumba prattae was an extinct species of small pigeon that lived during the Miocene in Florida.
This animal belongs to the bird family Columbidae, which includes modern pigeons and doves.
The species was described from a left coracoid fossil found at the Thomas Farm Site in Gilchrist County, northern Florida.
The genus name Arenicolumba refers to the sandy, fossil-rich sediments of the discovery site, combining Latin words for 'sandy place' and 'pigeon'.
Originally described in 1992 as Columbina prattae, the species was reclassified into the new genus Arenicolumba in 2008.
